findings.governingReading: he will ask her to overlook it or show lenience
findings.explanation: A plan to request lenience becomes the more controlling assertion that he will have Illya forgive him.

findings.highlight: You try to cover for yourself with simple words?
findings.evidenceJa: 簡単な言葉で終わらせるんだ
findings.governingReading: he means to end the matter with such easy words
findings.explanation: Illya objects to the apology’s inadequacy; the English adds a charge that Shirou is trying to excuse or conceal his own conduct.
A missing boundary fuses the interjection to Illya’s name.

findings.highlight: Without waiting for a response, she turns and dashes off.
findings.evidenceJa: 止める間もなく走り去っていく
findings.governingReading: she runs off before Shirou has time to stop her
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inability to intervene is changed into Illya declining to wait for a reply.

findings.highlight: I run after her, but I lose sight of her.
findings.evidenceJa: 追いつくどころかイリヤの背中さえ見失った
findings.governingReading: far from catching her, he loses sight even of her back
findings.explanation: The emphatic distance between catching Illya and merely keeping her in sight disappears.

findings.highlight: some way to make it up to her
findings.evidenceJa: 約束を破ってしまった謝罪も含めて、イリヤが喜ぶようなお返し
findings.governingReading: a recompense Illya will enjoy that also includes an apology for breaking the promise
findings.explanation: The dual purpose—pleasing Illya and explicitly apologizing for the broken promise—is compressed into generic amends.
